returns.name: Quarterly Wage & Contribution Report
contents: Due by April 30, July 31, October 31 and January 31 for the quarter covered; a report is required for each quarter an employer is covered, even if no wages were paid.
The Agency has no authority to grant extensions of time to file quarterly reports or to pay contributions; reimbursing employers pay in lieu of contributions within 30 days after being billed.
Forms are pre-printed with the employer's name, account number, due date, tax rate and taxable wage base ($32,100 for 2026; rates 2.43% to 5.4%, average 4.04%).
